method: pipeline/patches/2020_IN_HOUSE.py reads the certified district-by-county results (county FIPS included in the file) for all 9 districts and sums every district touching a county; party D -> dem, R -> rep, Libertarian/other -> oth.
validation: CSV statewide dem 1,194,901 / rep 1,738,745 / oth 62,798 vs sum of the 9 certified district totals (same file's StatewideSummary) dem 1,194,901 / rep 1,738,745 / oth 62,798: difference 0 / 0 (0.00%). All 53 counties present in MIT match the official values exactly.
